info.title: PolyOrderbooks API
info.description:
# PolyOrderbooks API

Historical Polymarket **crypto** and **sports** market data — discovery, prices, liquidity metrics, and L2 order books. Read paths query our historical data store; they never call Polymarket live.

## Categories

`api.polyorderbooks.com` serves **crypto** and **sports** from one API. Pass `category=crypto`
or `category=sports` to pin a request to one archive, or omit it for the union of both,
ordered by `updated_at` across archives.

## Base URL

`https://api.polyorderbooks.com`

## Authentication

All `/v1/*` data routes require an API key.

Send `X-API-Key: pob_…` or `Authorization: Bearer pob_…`. Dashboard JWT session tokens are **not** accepted on data routes.

## Plans (hosted)

| Plan | Req/min | Req/day | Finest resolution | History |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | 60 | 1,000 | 250ms | 3 days |
| Pro | 300 | 50,000 | 250ms | 30 days |

## Workflow

1. `GET /v1/markets` — discover
2. `GET /v1/markets/{id_or_slug}` — detail
3. `GET /v1/markets/{id_or_slug}/books` — history

post.description:
Turn a plain-English crypto up/down strategy, or a fully specified Strategy Builder spec, into a replayed backtest over resolved Polymarket markets from the archive. The `strategy` block in the response is the exact specification the engine executed.

Auth: `X-API-Key: pob_...` (or `Authorization: Bearer pob_...`). Available to any authenticated plan; plans differ in monthly run quotas and the history window. Over-quota calls return `429 limit_reached`.

200.description: Backtest completed. `report` holds the replayed trades and aggregate statistics; `analysis` is a plain-text post-run review.

example.prompt: Buy DOWN when the DOWN token price falls below 0.45 within the first 5 minutes of BTC 15m markets.
example.analysis:
Summary:
The DOWN-on-BTC 15m strategy closed 1 trade across 1 of 3 sampled markets for a net P&L of -$2.27.

Key Observations:
- The single trade exited at expiry for a -$2.27 loss.

Actionable Takeaway:
- Tighten the entry threshold or add a stop loss, then rerun to compare.

400.description: The request could not be turned into a strategy.

value.message: Buy signals must be token prices in (0,1]; percentages and external asset prices are unsupported.
Describe a strategy in words, or pass a structured strategy spec for the Strategy Builder.

401.description: API key is missing, invalid, or expired.

403.description: The plan does not meet the tier required for Backtest AI.

example.message: Backtest AI is a pro+ feature. Upgrade on the dashboard to unlock it.

429.description: Monthly Backtest AI quota reached, or the API rate limit exceeded.

value.message: Your plan allows up to 1 Backtest AI runs per month. Upgrade for unlimited backtesting and full history.
Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

get.summary: Get price history for every token in a market
get.description:
Get the full price history (probabilities from 0.0 to 1.0) for **all** outcomes of one market in a single request.

Use this when you want a market-wide price series — for example charting how a Yes/No market repriced over its life. One call returns every token, so you do not need to know token IDs in advance.

**When to use the token-scoped route instead:** if you already hold a CLOB token id and want only that one series, use `/v1/tokens/{token_id}/prices`. It returns a single token and is the cheaper call for that case.

**Pagination limits:**
- Default `limit`: 100 points per page
- Maximum `limit`: 200 points per page
- Use `cursor` from `metadata.next_cursor` to fetch the next page

**Aggregation:** Prices are averaged when aggregating to higher resolutions.

**Format:** JSON only. Covers Polymarket crypto and sports markets from the PolyOrderbooks historical archive.

get.summary: Get price history for one token by CLOB token id
get.description:
Get the historical price series (probabilities from 0.0 to 1.0) for a **single** token, addressed by its Polymarket CLOB token id.

Use this when you already know the token id — a persisted outcome id from your own catalog, or the `Yes` / `No` token returned by `/v1/markets/{id_or_slug}`.

**When to use the market-scoped route instead:** to pull every outcome of a market without knowing any token ids, use `/v1/markets/{id_or_slug}/prices`.

**Pagination limits:**
- Default `limit`: 100 points per page
- Maximum `limit`: 200 points per page
- Use `cursor` from `metadata.next_cursor` to fetch the next page

**Aggregation:** Prices are averaged when aggregating to higher resolutions.

**Format:** JSON only. Covers Polymarket crypto and sports markets from the PolyOrderbooks historical archive.

Resolution.title: Resolution
Resolution.description: Supported time resolutions for historical endpoints.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Series start timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Series end timestamp in ISO 8601 format, if closed.

SortField.title: SortField
SortField.description: Field to sort by. `updated_at` orders by when the market row was last refreshed; `start_date` and `end_date` order by the parent event window.

data.title: Data
data.description: Sorted list of unique tag strings.

TagListResponse.title: TagListResponse
TagListResponse.description:
Response for `GET /tags`.

Returns all unique event tags available for discovery filtering.
Tags are normalized to lowercase and sorted alphabetically.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable token label shown to users.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Whether historical market metrics are allowed.

books.title: Books
books.description: Whether historical order books are allowed.

UsageDataPointsResponse.title: UsageDataPointsResponse
UsageDataPointsResponse.description: Data point access controls for the current plan.

requests_per_minute.title: Requests Per Minute
requests_per_minute.description: Plan rate limit in requests per minute, or `unlimited` for uncapped plans.

requests_remaining.title: Requests Remaining
requests_remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current rate-limit window.

granularity_allowed.title: Granularity Allowed
granularity_allowed.description: Finest historical resolution allowed by plan.

max_history_days.title: Max History Days
max_history_days.description: Maximum rolling lookback window in days, or `unlimited` if uncapped.

data_points.description: Data point categories available under the current plan.

UsageLimitsResponse.title: UsageLimitsResponse
UsageLimitsResponse.description: Rate limit and granularity allowance for the current API key.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Plan name for the current API key.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Organization name associated with the API key.

reset_at.title: Reset At
reset_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the rate-limit window resets. Null for unlimited plans.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural-language strategy description, up to 1000 characters. Required unless `strategy` is provided.
examples: Buy DOWN when the DOWN token price falls below 0.45 within the first 5 minutes of BTC 15m markets.

days.title: Days
days.description: Backtest history window in days (1-30), capped by the plan (Starter: 1; paid plans: 30).

strategy.description: Structured Strategy Builder spec. Required unless `prompt` is provided.

BacktestAiRequest.title: BacktestAiRequest
BacktestAiRequest.description: Request body for `POST /v1/ai/backtest`. Provide a natural-language `prompt` or a structured `strategy` spec.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional human-readable name for the strategy.

coin.title: Coin
coin.description: Crypto asset, e.g. btc, eth, sol.

taker_fee.title: Taker Fee
taker_fee.description: Taker fee fraction applied per trade (optional).

trade_lag_seconds.title: Trade Lag Seconds
trade_lag_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after an entry signal before filling (optional).

max_trades_per_market.title: Max Trades Per Market
max_trades_per_market.description: Cap on trades opened per market (optional).

BacktestAiStrategy.title: BacktestAiStrategy
BacktestAiStrategy.description: Structured Strategy Builder spec for `POST /v1/ai/backtest`, also the exact spec form returned in the response.

within_seconds.description: Only while the market is less than this many seconds old.

take_profit.title: Take Profit
take_profit.description: Exit when the owned token's price crosses this level (optional).

stop_loss.title: Stop Loss
stop_loss.description: Exit when the owned token's price drops to this level (optional).

hold_to_expiry.title: Hold To Expiry
hold_to_expiry.description: Hold through settlement when no exit triggers (default true).

trailing_stop_activation.title: Trailing Stop Activation
trailing_stop_activation.description: Price level at which the trailing stop activates (optional).

max_hold_seconds.title: Max Hold Seconds
max_hold_seconds.description: Force exit after this many seconds in the trade (optional).

exit_before_close_seconds.title: Exit Before Close Seconds
exit_before_close_seconds.description: Force exit this many seconds before market close (optional).

BacktestAiExit.title: BacktestAiExit
BacktestAiExit.description: Exit rules for a backtest strategy.

fill_sources.title: Fill Sources
fill_sources.description: Count of entries by fill source.

skips.title: Skips
skips.description: Sampled markets that produced no trade (first 50, present only when non-empty).

skipped_total.title: Skipped Total
skipped_total.description: Total count of skipped markets when `skips` is present.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt the strategy was derived from.

strategy.description: The exact specification the engine executed (snake_case response form).

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Discover series, events, and markets. Use returned ids or slugs in History endpoints.

tags.name: History
tags.description: Historical metrics, prices, and L2 order book snapshots.

tags.name: Backtest AI
tags.description: Natural-language and Strategy Builder backtesting over resolved markets.
